certificateTrust.androidSteps: After downloading, go to Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate and choose the downloaded file. Menu names vary by manufacturer.

certificateTrust.qrHelp: The QR code refreshes every 10 minutes while this page is open. If Android can't open the .local address, open this page using the LAN IP and scan again.

certificateTrust.verifyHelp: After installing, check that the SHA-256 fingerprint in the device's certificate details matches the one above.

cloudDriveGuide.cacheSettingsTip: Set the cache limit and cleanup method in CloudDrive Settings, and choose LRU for cleanup. Don't set the limit to 0, and keep at least 40 GiB free on the system drive. Reopen the settings page afterward to confirm it saved.
cloudDriveGuide.cacheTypesTip: Buffer Cache uses memory, while disk cache and directory cache use disk space. Changing one doesn't limit the other two.
cloudDriveGuide.mountFirst: Mount the cloud drive as a local directory with CloudDrive2 or OpenList first, then choose it here.
cloudDriveGuide.readLengthTip: Set read length and download threads in each cloud drive's own download settings, starting threads at 2.
